safe_description: Contact address of the vendor's data protection officer
Issue date of the vendor's most recent SOC 2 Type II report

excerpt: SOC 2 Type II report covering 2025-07 to 2026-06 with no noted exceptions across security, availability, and confidentiality.
Customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher; keys are managed in a cloud KMS with annual rotation.
Recovery point objective 1 hour and recovery time objective 4 hours, tested twice yearly.
EU customer data is processed only in EU regions by the subprocessors listed in the EU addendum.
Customers are notified of confirmed security incidents affecting their data within 72 hours.

aliases: Is customer data encrypted at rest and in transit?
body: Yes. {{company_name}} encrypts customer data at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2+; keys are held in a cloud KMS and rotated annually.

aliases: Do you hold any security certifications or attestations?
Provide details of your SOC 2 report.
body: {{company_name}} holds a SOC 2 Type II report (issued {{soc2_report_date}}) covering security, availability, and confidentiality with no noted exceptions.

aliases: Describe your backup and disaster recovery capabilities.
body: Our recovery point objective is 1 hour and recovery time objective is 4 hours; disaster recovery is exercised twice a year.

aliases: Where is our data processed and by whom?
List your subprocessors and processing locations.
body: EU customer data is processed only in EU regions by the subprocessors in our EU addendum; our data protection officer can be reached at {{dpo_email}}.

aliases: How quickly are customers notified of a security incident?
body: Confirmed incidents affecting your data are notified within 72 hours, with a named incident manager and a post-incident report on request.

aliases: How quickly are customers notified of a security incident?
body: Confirmed incidents affecting your data are notified within 72 hours by email.
